title: RunParams
description: Params of the run agent tool (design §4.1): run a command in a session — the agent's lane — through the same submit path a person uses (the renderer's ordinary orchestration: block, ledger entry, attempt, output artifact, all minted at submit). The backend never writes to the PTY (design §2.1 — rejected). The session the tool may run in is bounded by the grant's session scopes, enforced by the narrowed capability (ADR-0028 decision 4); the window contract of the return (design §4.4) is the tool's return contract, not a parameter. The model is untrusted input and gets the same check the renderer's parameters get — additionalProperties: false plus an explicit required list.

sessionId.description: The session (the lane) the command runs in, inside the grant's session scopes.

command.description: The command to submit, exactly as a person would type it.
